gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8481 covers taps, cocks, valves and parts thereof; faucets are hand-operated valves
Section XVI note 2(b) / chapter 84: parts suitable for use solely or principally with valves go to 8481.90

rejected_alternatives.reason: of iron or steel; not indicated

missing_facts: material of the parts (copper/brass vs steel vs plastic/zinc)
classification.rationale: Faucets are hand-operated valves of 8481; parts go to 8481.90 by material. Brass is the default for faucet parts, so of copper; H208896 treats faucet parts under 8481.90.10.
